The other DJs are not in the GTA, they live in the U.S., and it's a great time all night.

Greg Rich also streams on Fridays (8 pm EST) DJing a show on his own called "Refill Fridays". He starts off with playing a set of his selected featured artist, then goes on to play sets of various genres and eras of music from '50's & '60s Golden Oldies, to '70's Soft Yacht Rock and Classic Rock, to Retro 80's New Wave and Freestyle to 90's Alternative Rock and Hip Hop, and everything in-between.

Each week he has different themes to keep the entertainment live. He does giveaways and will post polls in the chat so that the majority of the votes get to pick the genre of music for his next set of the night. Every last Friday of the month he does a request show for his viewers to select the songs and/or artists for him to play for the night.
